leadText: Volume 3 is the third volume published by VIZ Media compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. The chapters in this volume are collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures and are collected independently of Shogakukan's collected releases of the magazine version.
plainText:
Volume 3 is the third volume published by VIZ Media compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. The chapters in this volume are collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures and are collected independently of Shogakukan's collected releases of the magazine version.

==Blurb==
 Violet and Arven attempt to improve their battle skills through their encounters with wild Pokémon and Team Star in preparation to face the Titan Pokémon. Meanwhile, Scarlet continues her journey in search of the Treasures of Ruin.

Will Mabosstiff get cured?! 

==Publications==
 
 

==Chapters==
Adventure 7: Fierce Battle! The Stony Cliff Titan!!
Adventure 8: Acquisition! New Ability: Dash!!
Adventure 9: Challenge! The Avant-Garde Gym Leader!!
